name: IPQA
description: A benchmark for core intent identification in personalized question answering, focusing on identifying user-prioritized intents derived from observable answer selection behaviors. The dataset spans various domains and is constructed through systematic filtering, LLM-based annotation, and rigorous quality control combining automated verification with human validation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly appearing in the associated paper rather than as a widely standardized leaderboard.
notes: Addresses the gap in evaluating intent identification in personalized QA; current models struggle with core intent identification.
